limitations: fromTemplateName remains 'Default' in the manifest: creating a NATIVE SPECS Base Template project is documented as a GUI-only flow (Lens Studio home > SPECS > Base Template > File > Save As); neither the Editor API (only openProject/setDefaultProject/setEmptyProject - no create-from-template) nor the Lens Studio CLI (--exec: editor-api-export, export-lens, export-lso, project-update, run-script) can create a project from a template. The executed path is the official documented CONVERSION (Convert a Project to SPECS), applied to a copy, yielding the same functional baseline: Spectacles target, SPECS 27 preview, SPECS UI Kit + SIK packages, Perspective camera + DeviceTracking World + far 100000, SIK prefab in scene. A native-template project can still be created later in the GUI in under a minute if the user wants literal template provenance
